value: We also found diagnosis-by-sex interactions in the right precentral gyrus and left IFG. The interaction in the precentral gyrus was explained by reduced precentral gyrus activity in the female cocaine users, which was significantly lower than that observed in male cocaine users and female controls. In contrast, the interaction in the IFG was explained by increased IFG activity in the female cocaine users, which was significantly greater than that observed in male cocaine users and female controls; female controls instead activated this region to a lesser extent than male controls.
